investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-31T04:23:06–39Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable when POST /api/agents was called. Because every sibling check shares the exact same error message and no evidence was collected by any check, the failure is localized to the shared upstream swarm gateway dependency, not to any individual eval's logic or contract.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway backing POST /api/agents (routed through an AWS ELB in us-east-2) returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every remote-agent provisioning request during the eval window. This prevented the eval runner from receiving any agent creation response, so zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected and all three remote-agents checks failed with the same message. The root cause is a connectivity or availability failure at the swarm gateway layer, not in the eval runner or contract definitions. No suspect code changes are present in sourceDiscovery.suspectChanges to implicate a recent deployment.

investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval failed because the OpenAI API key used by the eval runner has no remaining credits, causing the upstream image generation call to return a credit_balance_exhausted error. investigations.rootCause: The AURA backend was temporarily unable to reach the upstream model provider for aura-gpt-5-5 at the time of the eval run (2026-08-31T04:22:38Z). investigations.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-runtime, remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state) failed at 2026-08-31T04:23 with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the POST /api/agents step — before any agent identity, model, or runtime response can be collected — all required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) are absent and the expected-output contract cannot be satisfied.
investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check that calls POST /api/agents received HTTP 502 with error code bad_gateway and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning", causing the agent provisioning step to abort before any evidence could be collected. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not a defect in the eval runner or the expected-output contract definitions.
